notes.title: First Demo Update (v0.4.1)
notes.content: [p]The first update for the SPACEROCKS Demo is now live! [/p][p][/p][p]The main issue players have reported so far is that the UI is too small and a lot of the text difficult to read, so this update aims to address that by scaling up almost all UI and text elements in the game.[/p][p]Information tabs have also been added to the Ship Upgrading interface to help new players navigate it.[/p][p][/p][p][b]PATCH NOTES 0.4.1[/b][/p][p][/p][p]- Many text and UI elements have been scaled up in size.[/p][p]- Added information tabs to the Ship Upgrade Screen.[/p][p]- Fixed an issue where some leaderboards could not be scrolled.[/p][p]- Fixed issues with changing window and resolution settings.[/p][p]- Various minor gameplay bug fixes.[/p][p][/p][p][/p]
